parsed.name: 串口I/O从控器
parsed.description: 一种通过串口通信的通用实验室I/O控制器，可按通道提供数字输出、模拟输出、模拟量读取和温度读取功能。常用于显微镜及其他实验装置中的外设联动、传感器采集和简单执行器控制。
parsed.description_en: A general-purpose laboratory I/O controller that communicates over a serial port and provides channel-based digital output, analog output, analog readback, and temperature readout. It is commonly used in microscopes and other experimental setups for peripheral coordination, sensor acquisition, and simple actuator control.
